title: Pipeline State Object (PSO) creation hitch
fix_rationale: PSO hitches occur when encountering novel shader/mesh/state combinations for the first time. Bundling a recorded PSO cache or enabling PSO precaching eliminates first-seen hitches.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms creating graphics or compute pipeline states on the {thread} thread ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Enable PSO Precaching in Project Settings (r.PSOPrecaching=1).
Record a Pipeline State Object (.rec.upipelinecache) playthrough and bundle the compiled PSO cache into your game package.
Pre-warm major gameplay shaders and particle PSOs during loading screens.

verify: Re-test the exact camera or ability activation in a packaged build with bundled PSO cache; check that PSO creation times drop to 0 ms.
caveats: In the editor, PSO precaching behaves differently and shader caches are invalidated frequently.
